label: Core update and spam
lines: The November 2026 core update finished on Nov. 24, and Google already preannounced a December core update.
Lily Ray shows folders that repeat one template thousands of times dropping fast, and Sistrix shows another big drop for Reddit.
Compare GSC data before and after Nov. 24, and audit templated, scaled AI and thin location pages before December.

label: AIOs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen
lines: Google moved Search to Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov. 17, with better intent understanding, smarter query fan-out and more links.
David Konitzny tracked 88M+ AIOs, and only 51.8% put the first inline link in the first third on Nov. 20, down from 76.8% on Sept. 21.
Recheck AIO citations for priority keywords, and answer the follow-up questions that fan-out asks.

label: AI visibility tracking
lines: New studies show that AI citations change fast, differ by platform and do not always bring traffic.
Kevin Indig found negative links between citations and referral traffic per model, and Semrush saw UGC citations grow 52% in Google's AI tools while they fell in ChatGPT.
Report citation trends over two or three weeks, and judge AI visibility by traffic and leads, not citations alone.

label: Content that earns visibility
lines: Google and SEO experts say generic and templated content loses, while real expertise and original data win.
In the November core update, Victoria Kurichenko's review posts gained 34% more daily clicks while her listicles lost 13%, and Lily Ray shows AI-scaled listicle sites hit hard.
Check each planned post for first-hand knowledge, original data and a named expert before we write it.

label: Local SEO and AI
lines: Ask Maps now calls local businesses for users, and Google is bringing it to Europe.
Whitespark found the business website in 86% of Maps Web Results across 21,000+ businesses.
Check each client's GBP call setting, keep websites and citations complete, and get reviews beyond Google.

label: WordPress and site health
lines: WordPress 7.1.5 fixes 18 flaws, and WordPress 7.2 ships Dec. 8 with a new /random/ URL that is on by default.
Rank Math had 16 flaws in 2026, and a hacked Optimizely script reached 178 organizations (Search Engine Journal).
Update core and Rank Math now, and decide before Dec. 8 which client sites need code to turn off /random/.

label: AI Mode inside Search
lines: Google keeps adding to AI Mode: a sidebar for past chats, Dive Deeper links, Connected Apps, Shopify checkout and an 'Ask anything' button in Google Images collections.
Google published a doc on attribution and factuality in AIOs and AI Mode, and still tests removing AI Mode from the top navigation.
Do not opt client sites out of AI features, since organic clicks dropped in Cyrus Shepard's opt-out test.

label: AI traffic and attribution
lines: Analytics undercount AI visits, but AI visitors often convert better than organic visitors.
Botpresso found that AI search brought about 1% of sessions but 2.5% of eCommerce revenue across 49 sites, and Tally gets 43% of new users from AI search.
Add a 'How did you hear about us?' field to client forms, report AI leads and revenue, and do not use Business Hub numbers as benchmarks yet.

label: Google Search Profiles
lines: Google Search Profiles are now live worldwide.
Barry Schwartz confirmed the rollout, and Lily Ray reports that Google flagged her Substack link with no way to dispute it.
Claim and complete Search Profiles for client authors, and check which links Google flags.

label: AI ads and paid search
lines: Ads, shopping results and coupon codes now show inside AI answers.
Writesonic found ads in 18.94% of ChatGPT answers on Nov. 16, and ChatGPT adds 'Black Friday' to its searches only when the shopper asks (Metehan Yeşilyurt).
Audit AI Max search terms, and put Black Friday deals on the best-of and review pages that AI already finds.

label: AI agents and crawlers
lines: Google, Microsoft and publishers now set new rules for AI agents and crawlers.
Google documented Google-Agent and 12 more fetchers and wants a Chrome permission system for agents, while Dow Jones now blocks all bots by default on WSJ.
Check robots.txt, firewall rules and logs for the new agents, and make sure bot protection never blocks Googlebot.

label: Search Console and Google tags
lines: GSC now takes feedback on big ranking changes, the API labels branded queries, and Google Tags are now Tag Manager containers.
Gaetano DiNardi and Alex Birkett found that non-branded clicks fell 35% YoY across 34 B2B sites, and branded clicks fell 19%.
Pull non-branded clicks from the API, and flag bot spikes before you report growth.

label: SEO vs GEO debate
lines: Big brands say SEO is dead, but SEO experts show that AI search still runs on SEO basics.
Salesforce's CEO posted 'Goodbye SEO', while OpenAI hires a B2B SEO and AEO lead at $239k to $265k.
Keep client budgets on SEO fundamentals, and skip AI schema and llms.txt add-ons that Neil Patel says Google Search ignores.

label: AI model and app launches
lines: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, and OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol in the ChatGPT Chat tab.
Neon set a day-1 usage record on Google's paid APIs (Sundar Pichai), and Claude now bundles connectors and skills as plugins.
Retest saved prompts on the new models, since answers and sources change.
